cases.basis: Lead review of #84 (task-11-contract.md, 'Lead review of #84'), MEDIUM ruling words: an Item 'containing the word total (any case, any position)' is a total row. 'Subtotal' contains `total` at a position other than the start, so under 'any position' it is a total row and not the exact label, hence refused. Reading 'word' as a whole word would accept it; I take 'any position' as the substring reading, which also keeps a subtotal from double-counting. See UNDECIDED r1. Code: pro_forma_rows, the code R-L17 label and Side failures raise (see cp1a-total-uses-side-source).
